name: Non-reconnected Multiresolution Isosurfacing
definition: Intentionally omits surface reconnection between adjacent cells of different resolutions to avoid tracking overhead, relying on sufficient polygon density to keep cracks visually negligible.
summary: Non-reconnected Multiresolution Isosurfacing is a fast surface extraction technique that omits geometric reconnection between adjacent cells to maintain interactive frame rates, relying on high polygon density to keep resulting cracks visually negligible.
